ledger.x: 27 December 1949: Dutch New Guinea stays Dutch.
October 1962: the United Nations takes over the administration.
1 May 1963: West New Guinea goes to Indonesia.

wars.name: Operation Trikora
wars.outcome: No Dutch defeat in the field: Indonesian infiltration from 15 January 1962 (Battle of Arafura Sea), Teminabuan taken on 21 May and Merauke attacked by paratroopers on 24 June, the planned Biak assault called off; the Netherlands signed the New York Agreement…
